group.description: Group every changelog version since the previous published release into one release body instead of exposing each intermediate version separately. includePrereleases.description: Let a prerelease version bound the grouped body even for a stable release (so the stable body only covers the changes since the latest prerelease).

since.description: Explicit lower boundary for the grouped body: a version or tag (eg. `1.2.0`, `v1.2.0`, `@scope/pkg@1.2.0`). Overrides the published-release lookup; a missing version falls back to automatic discovery.

ToolchainTsconfigConfig.description: Workspace tsconfig generation (path aliases + project references).

include.description: Only auto-wire entries matching these globs (`auto`: workspace dirs; `aliasAuto`: rewritten alias keys; `refsAuto`: reference paths).

exclude.description: Skip entries matching these globs (same targets as `include`).

rewriteAlias.description: Rewrite the alias keys auto-wiring generates (custom keys are preserved). Patterns are URL-rewrite style: a string is a regular-expression source and replacements support `$1`, `$2`, ... capture groups. Examples: `{ "^@org/(.+)$": "@org/pkg/$1" }` (string patterns), `[{ pattern: /^@org\/(.+)$/, replacement: "@org/pkg/$1" }]` (RegExp patterns), `[{ pattern: ["^@org/a$", "^@org/b$"], replacement: "@org/x" }]` (an array of keys), and an array of such rules (applied in order; the first matching rule wins). `RegExp` patterns are only available from TS/JS configs; JSON configs use string patterns.

modes.description: Alias discovery: `auto` (exports, then the project structure), `exports` (package.json exports/types/main only), `project-structure` (scan the source tree), or an array combining `exports` and `project-structure`.

prefix.description: Prefix for generated aliases instead of the package scope (eg. `@` produces `@/<package>` and `@/<package>/<subpath>`).

devMode.description: Resolve generated aliases to source files. Set false to point at the distributed files instead.

dist.description: Output directory used to map source/dist targets (default: the workspace tsconfig's `outDir`, then `dist`).

include.description: Only auto-wire entries matching these globs (`auto`: workspace dirs; `aliasAuto`: rewritten alias keys; `refsAuto`: reference paths).

exclude.description: Skip entries matching these globs (same targets as `include`).

base.description: Deep-merged into the root base tsconfig (`baseFile`) during sync.

default.description: Deep-merged into every workspace default tsconfig (`defaultFile`) during sync.

build.description: Deep-merged into every workspace build tsconfig (`buildFile`) during sync.

root.description: Deep-merged into the root workspaces tsconfig (`rootFile`) during sync.

ToolchainTsconfigOverrides.description: Managed overrides deep-merged into the base/root/default/build tsconfig files during sync. The originals are snapshotted in the manifest, so removing a key reverts it (restoring the original value when the file defined one).

tsconfig.description: The tsconfig the config loader uses. `true` selects the nearest `tsconfig.json`; a string selects a different file (relative to the project root); `false` disables tsconfig resolution.

enabled.description: Enable/disable this section (default: enabled when defined).

regenerate.description: Regenerate this section's managed files during `dbx sync`. When false, existing files are left untouched and are neither written nor drift-checked.

sources.description: Extra sources on top of the builtin + registry sources.

enabled.description: Enable/disable this section (default: enabled when defined).

regenerate.description: Regenerate this section's managed files during `dbx sync`. When false, existing files are left untouched and are neither written nor drift-checked.

locate.description: A builtin id, local dir, npm scope, git URL or Vite+ id.

registry.description: Custom npm registry URL (default: the project package manager registry).

subdir.description: Subdirectory within the source that holds the template.

online.description: Whether the source needs network access.

ToolchainTemplateSource.description: A template source: builtin, local, npm, git or Vite+.

templates.description: Allow/deny globs for template sources and registries.

providers.description: Allow/deny globs for provider sources and registries.

enabled.description: Enable/disable this section (default: enabled when defined).

regenerate.description: Regenerate this section's managed files during `dbx sync`. When false, existing files are left untouched and are neither written nor drift-checked.

allow.description: Allowed host/path globs. When non-empty, only matching sources are used (eg. `*.example.com`, `https://registry.example.com/**`).

packages.description: The default catalog: package name -> version range.

enabled.description: Enable/disable this section (default: enabled when defined).

regenerate.description: Regenerate this section's managed files during `dbx sync`. When false, existing files are left untouched and are neither written nor drift-checked.

ToolchainCatalogsConfig.description: Package catalogs written to the package manager catalog file (`catalog:`).

config.description: Write the managed Vite config. A string sets its file name/path (relative to the project, or an absolute path inside it).

shim.description: How the generated `vite.config.ts` is rendered. `runtime` loads the config from `dbx.config.*`; `static` serializes it into the file so the shim does not import `@deltabox/toolchain` (it then needs no built `dist`).

shimImport.description: Module specifier used to import `resolveVite` in runtime shims (default `@deltabox/toolchain/vite`; the legacy `vite-plugin-dbx` is still accepted). A relative path is resolved from the repo root and rewritten relative to each generated config - useful for dogfooding a source checkout without a built `dist`.

anyOf.description: Oxfmt configuration options.

fmt.description: Oxfmt options; `true` uses the toolchain defaults.

anyOf.description: Oxlint configuration options.

lint.description: Oxlint options; `true` uses the toolchain defaults.

enabled.description: Enable/disable this section (default: enabled when defined).

regenerate.description: Regenerate this section's managed files during `dbx sync`. When false, existing files are left untouched and are neither written nor drift-checked.

ToolchainViteConfig.description: The full Vite+ config; `dbx sync` writes the root `vite.config.ts` from it.

exclude.description: Glob(s) excluded from watching. Defaults to the common ignored paths (`node_modules`, `.dbx`, `dist`, `build`, ...).

gitignore.description: Also respect `.gitignore` files (root + nested) when watching.

enabled.description: Enable/disable this section (default: enabled when defined).

regenerate.description: Regenerate this section's managed files during `dbx sync`. When false, existing files are left untouched and are neither written nor drift-checked.

enabled.description: Format the managed files after writing them (default true once enabled).

fix.description: Rewrite the managed files with the formatter (default true). Set false to run the formatter in check mode instead.

command.description: Override the formatter command. `{files}` expands to the managed files (space-separated); when it is absent the files are appended.

exclude.description: Globs of managed files to leave unformatted (per-file opt-out).

format.description: Opt-in formatting of the managed files after generation. `true` uses the defaults, `false` disables it, and an object tunes `enabled`/`fix`/`command`/`exclude`.

enabled.description: Enable/disable this section (default: enabled when defined).

regenerate.description: Regenerate this section's managed files during `dbx sync`. When false, existing files are left untouched and are neither written nor drift-checked.

ToolchainSyncConfig.description: `dbx sync` behaviour (formatting of the managed files).

suppress.description: Warning/error id, message substring, or `/regex/` to silence (single value or array).

write.description: Write to a specific output channel.

logger.description: Custom `ToolchainLogger` implementation (TS/JS configs only; JSON cannot carry functions).

enabled.description: Enable/disable this section (default: enabled when defined).

regenerate.description: Regenerate this section's managed files during `dbx sync`. When false, existing files are left untouched and are neither written nor drift-checked.

ToolchainLoggerConfig.description: Logging level, colours and prefix for toolchain output.

color.description: Force provider command colours on/off (default: inherit the logger).

enabled.description: Enable/disable this section (default: enabled when defined).

regenerate.description: Regenerate this section's managed files during `dbx sync`. When false, existing files are left untouched and are neither written nor drift-checked.

ToolchainProvidersConfig.description: Provider command behaviour (eg. colour for the passthrough commands).

afterLoad.description: Runs after the config is loaded and its tokens are resolved.

beforeSync.description: Runs once before the sync tasks.

afterTask.description: Runs after each sync task, with the files it produced (if any).

afterSync.description: Runs once after the sync tasks with the result summary.

beforeVersion.description: Runs after the bump is planned and before `dbx changelog` writes versions/changelogs.

afterVersion.description: Runs after `dbx changelog` writes the new versions and changelogs.

ToolchainHooks.description: Lifecycle hooks (functions; TS/JS configs only). Return values are awaited.
